title: Favorite New Orleans clarinetists: Dodds, Noone and others
summary: Jernberg praises Johnny Dodds, Rappolo and a soft-toned clarinetist from the Apex Club, over Teschemacher and similar players.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Who do you remember from the New Orleans gang playing at Shields Impresso?

Well, yes, I liked Shields playing and Rapoli with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings, or Rapolo or whatever his name was. He was all right, too. And of course, Johnny Dodds with Joe Oliver. Oh, Jesus. He was great. I thought he was wonderful.
Did you ever hear Jimmy known him?
